events.title: Matsue Castle (National Treasure)
events.description: Original wooden keep with wide moats and samurai quarter—one of Japan’s few surviving main towers.

events.title: Lake Shinji Sunset (Shimane Art Museum Lawn)
events.description: Beloved golden-hour vista on Matsue’s waterfront—locals gather for ‘Top 100 Sunsets in Japan’.

events.title: Yūshien Garden (Daikonshima)
events.description: Peony-famous island garden with ponds and bridges in brackish Nakaumi—seasonal flowers year-round.
